quest.title: Wanmin Fresh
quest.description: Wanmin Restaurant has taken a custom order that now awaits delivery...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Mystic Enhancement Ore x2

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have other things to do.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Alright. Let's see, who else can enter Jueyun Karst as they please, I wonder...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Please take care while traveling to Jueyun Karst. <color=#00E1FFFF>Don't fly about or climb any way you like</color>, or I fear that we might anger the adepti.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Don't touch any strange elements</color>, either, or you'll ruin the taste.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Laid Back Ling'guan

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Oh, you're here at last. Thanks a lot!

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Why, eating this makes me feel luckier already.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: A guest named Ling'guan ordered some Come And Get It from us, mentioning that it should be delivered to Jueyun Karst at a later time.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: As if Jueyun Karst was a border that ordinary mortals could trespass!

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Ahem. Well, whatever the case, could you help us deliver this order to Jueyun Karst? Let's see if we can get it there in time.

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Eh...? Where is this? I was just walking around, wasn't I?
